domain(person,[natalie,colby]).

% Natalie draws from inspiration.
axiom(s1, draws_from_inspiration(natalie)).

% If Natalie has creative expression, then she experiments with techniques and produces unique work.
axiom(s2, rule([creative_expression(natalie)], and(experiments_with_techniques(natalie), produces_unique_work(natalie)))).

% Natalie enjoys art or has creative expression.
axiom(s3, or(enjoys_art(natalie), creative_expression(natalie))).

% If Natalie appreciates classics, then she is a traditional artist and values originality.
axiom(s4, rule([appreciates_classics(natalie)], and(traditional_artist(natalie), values_originality(natalie)))).

% If Natalie is inspired by history, then she is either a traditional artist or a free-spirited artist, but not both.
axiom(s5, rule([inspired_by_history(natalie)], xor(traditional_artist(natalie), free_spirited_artist(natalie)))).

% Natalie values originality.
axiom(s6, values_originality(natalie)).

% Natalie either admires masters or appreciates classics.
axiom(s7, or(admires_masters(natalie), appreciates_classics(natalie))).

% Natalie follows artistic rules.
axiom(s8, follows_artistic_rules(natalie)).

% If Natalie has visionary talent, then she is a free-spirited artist or captures the essence of beauty (or both).
axiom(s9, rule([visionary_talent(natalie)], or(free_spirited_artist(natalie), captures_essence_of_beauty(natalie)))).

% Anyone who draws from inspiration either has creative expression or innovates their style (or both).
axiom(s10, rule([draws_from_inspiration(X)], or(creative_expression(X), innovates_style(X)))).

% If Natalie either explores new colors or pushes boundaries (but not both), then she innovates her style.
axiom(s11, rule([xor(explores_new_colors(natalie), pushes_boundaries(natalie))], innovates_style(natalie))).

% Natalie is inspired by history.
axiom(s12, inspired_by_history(natalie)).

% Colby either admires masters or appreciates classics.
axiom(s13, or(admires_masters(colby), appreciates_classics(colby))).

% Anyone who explores colors and experiments with brushstrokes can produce unique work.
axiom(s14, rule([explores_colors(X), experiments_with_brushstrokes(X)], produces_unique_work(X))).

% Natalie does not admire masters.
axiom(s15, not(admires_masters(natalie))).

% A person either innovates their style or follows artistic rules, but not necessarily both.
axiom(s16, forall(var(x,person), or(innovates_style(var(x)), follows_artistic_rules(var(x))))).
